description: This file defines the FormattedTextArea class, which is responsible for rendering a formatted text area within a PDF document, including calculating dimensions, formatting content, and managing rendering information.

classes.name: FormattedTextArea
classes.description: Represents a formatted text area capable of formatting and rendering textual content within a PDF document.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Performs formatting of the text area using a provided graphics context.

methods.name: InnerWidth
methods.description: Property to get or set the inner width of the text area, calculating inherent width if necessary.

methods.name: CalcInherentWidth
methods.description: Calculates the minimum width required to render the content without overflow.

methods.name: GetRenderInfos
methods.description: Returns the list of rendering information objects for the formatted content.

methods.name: ContentHeight
methods.description: Calculates the total height of the rendered content.
